from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document containing its identifier and stated case cause."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document title or identifier (e.g., 'Document 1', '《判决文书 15》')")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The case cause (案由) explicitly stated or summarized in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
